== Notes ==
* Damage triggers when the target receives a physical damage [[packet]], even a packet of 0 damage.
* The target foe with this hex will not take the damage, only foes adjacent to him.
* This skill causes the [[area damage over time]] scatter effect.
* Combines well with a high number of [[minion]]s.
* Synergy with [[Hundred Blades]] or [[Vow of Strength]] as the damage they deal is [[Damage type|physical]].
